routineText:
-----------------------
| 🌅 Breakfast
| — whole wheat bread 100g
| — oat 20g + warm water (or Jaouda Sans Lactose milk)
| — 1 banana (~120g)
| — mint tea (2 cups) + 2 tsp sugar
-----------------------

-----------------------
| ☀️ Lunch
| — minced meat (kefta 90/10) 250g raw
| — legume sauté ~300g (carrot / courgette / onion), as always
| — 5g raw olive oil (↓ from 20g) + 10g cooking olive oil
| — cumin & salt
-----------------------

-----------------------
| 🌙 Dinner
| — 3 scoops of protein powder
| — 250g raib (homemade, from Jaouda Sans Lactose)
| — nuts, 5g of each: almonds, walnuts, cashews, pistachios, pumpkin seeds
-----------------------

💧 Water — 3L across the day

adjustments.reason: The 20g raw drizzle is 4× your usual 5g and single-handedly pushed fat to the 114% ceiling. Trimming only the raw pour — cooking oil untouched — lands fat at 93% and calories at 96%, with all four macros in range. Ties to the 70g fat ceiling and the belly-fat goal.

adjustments.to: Oats with warm water (or the Jaouda Sans Lactose milk)
adjustments.reason: Your standard oats prep is warm water. Plain milk is on the gas list, so if the 'bits of milk' were regular milk, switch to warm water; if it was the lactose-free Jaouda, you're fine. Either way the macro effect is negligible (~30 kcal).

verdict.text_html: Rest day, good — all four macros land in range once the oversized 20g raw-oil pour is trimmed to 5g (96% calories, ~70 under)

good: All four macros land good after one change — protein 98%, carbs 105%, fat 93%, calories 96% — trimming only the oversized raw-oil pour did it
Kefta 250g is a powerhouse — B12 275%, Zinc 118%, and the day's iron (~86%) is the best in a while
250g raib (+ a little milk) makes this the rotation's best calcium day and a real live-culture probiotic serving
Carrot in the legume sauté carries Vitamin A to 120%
bad: The 20g raw olive-oil pour was 4× your usual 5g — it alone pushed fat to the 114% ceiling before the trim
No eggs today, so Choline (45%) and Biotin (67%) drop well below their usual levels
No kiwi or apple — Vitamin C falls to ~33%, the day's weakest vitamin
Usual structural gaps stay: Vitamin D (7%), Chromium (11%), Iodine (17%), Vitamin E (27%); fiber short at 63%
